description: RockBoard PedalSafe type library. A PedalSafe is a transparent rubber pedal cover that clips to a QuickMount plate; a type is a cover family, keyed to the pedal housing it protects, not a specific model. fits_quickmount_type names the plate the cover clips to, so plate geometry comes from quickmount_types.json rather than being repeated here.

caveats: housing_dimensions_mm is the pedal housing the cover is made for, in W x D x H as published; it is not the cover outline.
Only some product pages publish a housing size or a mounting hole distance, so absent fields are unknown, not zero.

fits_quickmount_type is resolved from the QuickMount drawing each PedalSafe page links. Type B is one of these but is not sold as a QuickMount product type, so it is absent from quickmount_types.json.
Sibling types share a universal baseplate: the -UNI sheets for A1/A2, D1/D2 and K1/K2 are byte-identical on the CDN.

provenance.source: the published spec sheet on each page of https://www.rockboard.de/en/pedalsafes/ and the drawings in ref/pedalsafes

shared_drawings.note: universal baseplate linked from the B2 and B3 pages; B1 has its own UNI sheet, and the sheet is byte-identical to the A1/A2 and D1/D2 and K1/K2 pairs
